sources.file: UG718-1.0.4E_Arora Ⅴ 60K FPGA Products Programming and Configuration Guide.pdf

core_schematic_flash.N20: B5_B70_P/IOR70A/SSPI_WPN/SSI2; separate from U13 MSPI_WP; leads to core P1-69 on PDF page30

base_schematic.N20_route: B5_B70_P to P16 FMC C26; adapter converts to P2-3

hardware_manual.printed_page16: MODE001 MasterSPI and6 MSPI configuration balls

vendor_guide.configuration_phase: Configuration function is default until configuration succeeds
vendor_guide.user_phase: SSPI_CS_N, SSPI_CLK, SI, SO, CLKHOLD_N, SSPI_WPN can become GPIO by SSPI-port reuse option
vendor_guide.ms_pi_and_jtag: Independent reuse options; do not enable MSPI-asGPIO or JTAG-asGPIO
vendor_guide.N20_uses: SSPI_WPN/SSI2 is in the whole SSPI reuse group, not an independently selectable single-WPN setting

v141_build_requirement.P3_N22_M22: intentionally unassigned by this design even though SSPI group is reused
v141_build_requirement.scope: Preserve MSPI Flash wiring/options. User-mode SSPI interface is repurposed to GPIO, so do not claim user-mode SSPI background access is preserved.
